');const embeddedBytes=new Uint8Array(embeddedBinary.length);for(let i=0;i<embeddedBinary.length;i++)embeddedBytes[i]=embeddedBinary.charCodeAt(i);video.src=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([embeddedBytes],{type:'video/mp4'}));

const cols=160,rows=90,chars='   ..,:;irsXA253hMHGS#9B&@';small.width=cols;small.height=rows;ctx.textBaseline='top';ctx.font='9px Consolas,Monaco,monospace';ctx.shadowBlur=0;let raf=0,recorder=null;let outroMode='video',fadeStarted=0,riseStarted=0,wishStarted=0;const lanternPrompt=document.querySelector('#lanternPrompt'),lanternButtons=[...lanternPrompt.querySelectorAll('.lanternChoice')],outroScene=document.querySelector('#outroScene'),wishLantern=document.querySelector('#wishLantern'),wishPrompt=document.querySelector('#wishPrompt'),wishMessage=document.querySelector('#wishMessage');let lanternChoiceShown=false;
function draw(){const now=performance.now();if(outroMode==='video'||outroMode==='fade'){ctx.fillStyle='#07070a';ctx.fillRect(0,0,1280,720);if(video.readyState>=2){sctx.drawImage(video,0,0,cols,rows);const d=sctx.getImageData(0,0,cols,rows).data;for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const i=(y*cols+x)*4,r=d[i],g=d[i+1],b=d[i+2],lum=.2126*r+.7152*g+.0722*b;let idx=Math.min(chars.length-1,Math.floor(lum/256*chars.length));if(idx===0)continue;ctx.fillStyle='rgb('+r+','+g+','+b+')';ctx.fillText(chars[idx],x*8,y*8)}}if(outroMode==='fade'){const alpha=Math.min(1,(now-fadeStarted)/2800);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+alpha+')';ctx.fillRect(0,0,1280,720);if(alpha>=1){outroMode='lantern';outroScene.classList.add('visible');outroScene.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false')}}}else{ctx.fillStyle='#050508';ctx.fillRect(0,0,1280,720)}raf=requestAnimationFrame(draw)}
function fmt(s){if(!isFinite(s))return'00:00';return`${String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(Math.floor(s%60)).padStart(2,'0')}`}
canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(outroMode==='video'&&video.paused&&!lanternPrompt.classList.contains('show'))video.play().then(()=>{play.textContent='Ⅱ พักเพลง'}).catch(()=>{})});wishLantern.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(outroMode!=='lantern')return;outroMode='rising';riseStarted=performance.now();outroScene.classList.add('launched');wishLantern.classList.add('launch')});wishLantern.addEventListener('animationend',event=>{if(event.animationName==='lantern-ascend'&&outroMode==='rising'){outroMode='wish';wishMessage.classList.add('show')}});video.addEventListener('loadeddata',()=>{loading.style.display='none';draw();video.play().then(()=>{play.textContent='Ⅱ พักเพลง'}).catch(()=>{})});lanternButtons.forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!lanternChoiceShown||!lanternPrompt.classList.contains('show'))return;lanternButtons.forEach(item=>item.disabled=true);button.classList.add('selected');video.play().then(()=>{play.disabled=false;play.textContent='Ⅱ พักเพลง';window.setTimeout(()=>{lanternPrompt.classList.remove('show');lanternPrompt.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')},220)}).catch(()=>{play.disabled=false;lanternPrompt.classList.remove('show');lanternPrompt.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');loading.style.display='grid';loading.textContent='กดเล่นพร้อมเพลงอีกครั้งเพื่อดำเนินต่อ'})}));video.addEventListener('timeupdate',()=>{if(lanternChoiceShown&&video.currentTime<90)lanternChoiceShown=false;if(!lanternChoiceShown&&video.currentTime>=90){lanternChoiceShown=true;lanternButtons.forEach(item=>{item.disabled=false;item.classList.remove('selected')});video.pause();lanternPrompt.classList.add('show');lanternPrompt.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');play.textContent='▶ เล่นพร้อมเพลง';play.disabled=true;lanternButtons[0].focus()}fill.style.width=(video.duration?video.currentTime/video.duration*100:0)+'%';document.querySelector('#seek').setAttribute('aria-valuenow',String(video.duration?Math.round(video.currentTime/video.duration*100):0));time.textContent=fmt(video.currentTime)+' / '+fmt(video.duration)});video.addEventListener('ended',()=>{lanternChoiceShown=false;outroMode='fade';fadeStarted=performance.now()});video.addEventListener('error',()=>{loading.textContent='เปิดไฟล์นี้ด้วย Chrome หรือ Edge เพื่อเล่นวิดีโอ'});
play.addEventListener('click',async()=>{if(lanternPrompt.classList.contains('show'))return;if(video.paused){try{await video.play();play.textContent='Ⅱ พักเพลง'}catch(e){loading.style.display='grid';loading.textContent='เปิดไฟล์ MP4 แล้วกดเล่นอีกครั้ง'}}else{video.pause();play.textContent='▶ เล่นพร้อมเพลง'}});
const seek=document.querySelector('#seek');function seekTo(target){if(!video.duration)return;target=Math.max(0,Math.min(video.duration,target));const promptOpen=lanternPrompt.classList.contains('show'),leavingOutro=outroMode!=='video';if(promptOpen&&target>=90)return;if(target<90)lanternChoiceShown=false;if(promptOpen){lanternPrompt.classList.remove('show');lanternPrompt.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');lanternButtons.forEach(item=>{item.disabled=false;item.classList.remove('selected')});play.disabled=false}if(leavingOutro){outroMode='video';fadeStarted=0;riseStarted=0;wishStarted=0;outroScene.classList.remove('visible','launched');outroScene.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');wishLantern.classList.remove('launch');wishPrompt.classList.remove('fade');wishMessage.classList.remove('show');canvas.style.cursor='default'}video.currentTime=target;if(promptOpen||leavingOutro)video.play().then(()=>{play.textContent='Ⅱ พักเพลง'}).catch(()=>{})}function seekFromPointer(e){const r=seek.getBoundingClientRect();seekTo((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*video.duration)}seek.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!video.duration)return;seek.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);seekFromPointer(e)});seek.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(e.buttons&1)seekFromPointer(e)});seek.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault();seekTo(video.currentTime+(e.key==='ArrowLeft'?-5:5))}});document.querySelector('#restart').addEventListener('click',async()=>{lanternChoiceShown=false;lanternPrompt.classList.remove('show');lanternPrompt.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');lanternButtons.forEach(item=>{item.disabled=false;item.classList.remove('selected')});play.disabled=false;outroMode='video';fadeStarted=0;riseStarted=0;wishStarted=0;outroScene.classList.remove('visible','launched');outroScene.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');wishLantern.classList.remove('launch');wishPrompt.classList.remove('fade');wishMessage.classList.remove('show');canvas.style.cursor='default';video.currentTime=0;try{await video.play();play.textContent='Ⅱ พักเพลง'}catch(e){}});
exp.addEventListener('click',async()=>{if(lanternPrompt.classList.contains('show')&&recorder?.state!=='recording')return;if(!video.captureStream||!window.MediaRecorder){alert('เบราว์เซอร์นี้ยังบันทึก WebM ไม่ได้ กรุณาเปิดด้วย Chrome หรือ Edge');return}if(recorder?.state==='recording'){recorder.stop();return}if(video.paused){await video.play();play.textContent='Ⅱ พักเพลง'}const stream=canvas.captureStream(24),audio=video.captureStream();audio.getAudioTracks().forEach(t=>stream.addTrack(t));const mime=['video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus','video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus','video/webm'].find(MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported);if(!mime){alert('WebM encoding is not supported in this browser.');return}const chunks=[];recorder=new MediaRecorder(stream,{mimeType:mime,videoBitsPerSecond:4500000});recorder.ondataavailable=e=>{if(e.data.size)chunks.push(e.data)};recorder.onstop=()=>{const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(chunks,{type:'video/webm'}));a.download='I-See-the-Light-ASCII.webm';a.click();exp.textContent='⇩ บันทึกคลิป';exp.disabled=false;stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop())};recorder.start(1000);exp.textContent='● กำลังบันทึก · กดเพื่อจบ';exp.disabled=false;video.onended=()=>recorder?.state==='recording'&&recorder.stop()});
})();
